posts.title: Job Hunt
posts.description: After finishing up at GitLab in late June by accepting Voluntary Departure due to the Act 2 announcements in May, I hunted for a new full time job. Like thousands of others in this industry. I don't think my experience is particularly noteworthy, but it is interesting to write down.

posts.title: LLM Musings
posts.description: Like most people in tech in the year of our lord 2026 I have opinions about AI. None of these are particularly unique (probably), but I want to get them written down.

posts.title: Static site
posts.description: Blogs have gone through various styles over the years; static hand-crafted posts, forum-based, CMS's (Drupal, Wordpress), and back to static sites. I used Joomla for a while, but never got the hang of it.
